# Crossbows (skill)

Description: Determines, damage, ,, stamina, cost and, reload time, with Crossbows (skill).

# Introduction

Crossbows is a skill related to Crossbows weapon class.

## Effects

Higher skill level in crossbows increases damage and knockback up to +141% and reduces reload time down to -50%, indirectly reducing stamina usage.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

## Leveling up

The player gains 1xp per bolt when hitting a creature.
